external.name: Necrowave
external.why: A hand-animated exploration platformer built around lethal, tactical encounters. A creator-supported development project, not a finished commercial release.
external.requirements: Use the public build offered by the creator. Patreon support and any paid early-access tiers are separate.

external.name: Stratum
external.why: A small first-person labyrinth with compact movement upgrades. A short, free discovery rather than a sprawling commercial campaign.

external.name: Fiend's Fall
external.why: A bite-sized browser Metroidvania with multiple endings and a concentrated exploration loop.

external.name: Rabbit's Quest
external.why: A substantial free run-and-gun exploration adventure with multiple regions and character upgrades.

external.name: A Mini Falafel Adventure
external.why: A free, compact adventure with inventive bosses and an intentionally silly premise. A strong freeware discovery.

external.name: Angel Shell
external.why: A short underwater exploration game built around a grappling hook, with a distinctly small-scale indie identity.

external.name: Reawakening
external.why: A free mining-suit exploration adventure, suited to players who like uncovering a world through tools and movement upgrades.

external.name: Senescence Protocol
external.why: A short, top-down jam-scale exploration game. Kept separate from the long-form genre essentials.

external.name: Spellsought
external.why: A small creator-hosted spellcasting exploration game for the deep-cut shelf.

external.name: Peppermint
external.why: A candy-and-horror pixel-art exploration prototype. The available build is not presented as the completed game.

external.name: Mongrel Story
external.why: A creator-hosted exploration demo. Useful as a discovery, with its demo status visible rather than counted as a full release.

external.name: BLOCK
external.why: A minimalist metroidbrainia where understanding the rules opens new possibilities. A puzzle-led neighbor, not a combat-heavy Metroidvania.

external.name: Fohh
external.why: A short gravity-driven dinosaur exploration prototype with a playful visual identity.

external.name: Momodora II
external.why: The early freeware Momodora entry that shifted the series toward interconnected exploration. An archival favorite with older-PC compatibility considerations.

external.name: Lyle in Cube Sector
external.why: A distinctive freeware classic where throwing cubes and acquiring new abilities unlock a strange interconnected world.

external.name: Hero Core
external.why: A compact, monochrome shooting-and-exploration classic. The original desktop game is distinct from later fan ports.

external.name: Castlevania Requiem: Symphony of the Night & Rondo of Blood
external.why: An official modern route to Symphony of the Night, bundled with the stage-based Rondo of Blood. One collection record, with both games searchable.
external.requirements: PlayStation edition. Rondo of Blood is a stage-based action game, not a Metroidvania; Symphony of the Night is the exploration recommendation.

external.name: Metroid Dread
external.why: A modern 2D genre benchmark with fluid movement and high-pressure encounters. Kept on an explicitly console-only shelf, not passed off as a Steam game.

external.name: Metroid Prime Remastered
external.why: First-person exploration, scanning and interconnected alien environments. An official console remaster of a genre cornerstone.

external.name: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
external.why: The newer first-person Metroid entry, cataloged through Nintendo rather than an invented PC edition.

coverageNote: Discovery includes the full 2026 genre index, curated classics and deep cuts, exact Steam metadata, GOG, creator itch.io pages, publisher links and public creator support. No search miss is treated as proof of absence.
